description: The Eurasian treecreeper (Wikipedia): overview, description and distribution, as three sections.
note: One of this corpus's first two three-source pairs (with mahjongg). Read directly: the three sources are three sections of the Wikipedia article on the Eurasian treecreeper -- overview and behaviour (source_a.md), physical description and calls (source_b.md), and distribution and habitat, which cites en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurasian_treecreeper (source_c.md). reference.md joins all three in that order, each under its own heading. Checked, not just skimmed: all 40 of reference.md's sentences (src/llossless/segment.py's unit) appear verbatim in some source, and reconcile.reconcile reads it as a three-way staple (order.stapled=True, runs=3) -- like sepia, this reference is a reference for content coverage, not for merge quality, and the same caution applies.
